ABOUT ME

I’m a video editor who enjoys turning raw footage into meaningful and engaging visual stories. I care about pacing, atmosphere, sound and the small details that make an edit feel authentic.

I’m especially drawn to documentary-style storytelling, while also enjoying cinematic and creative projects that let the visuals speak.
